UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private RosoFood AI user account profile and personal daily nutrition goals.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

dailyGoals.description: User daily calorie and macronutrient targets.

dietProfile.description: Optional body metrics (age, heightCm, weightKg, sex), activity level, fitness goal, dietary preference, and dailyBudgetInr for personalized diet coaching and meal planning.

TrackedMeal.title: TrackedMeal
TrackedMeal.description: A single analyzed meal or fruit entry logged privately to a user's food diary.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the meal owner.

dateKey.description: Local calendar date key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

loggedAtIso.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the meal was logged.

imageThumbnailDataUrl.description: Optional compact JPEG thumbnail data URL.

analysis.description: Structured Gemini Vision nutrition analysis payload.

MealPlan.title: MealPlan
MealPlan.description: A personalized 5-meal Indian daily diet plan saved privately by a user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the meal plan owner.

planName.description: User-facing label for the saved meal plan.

input.description: User parameters (age, heightCm, weightKg, sex, fitnessGoal, activityLevel, dietaryPreference, dailyBudgetInr) used to generate the plan.

targetDailyCaloriesKcal.description: Safe calculated daily calorie target (>= 1200 kcal).

estimatedBmrKcal.description: Mifflin-St Jeor Basal Metabolic Rate estimate.

safetyNote.description: Safety explanation and calorie pace guidance.

hydrationTip.description: Daily hydration and meal timing tip.

budgetSummary.description: Summary of how affordable Indian staples fit the daily food budget.

totals.description: Estimated daily calories, protein, carbs, fat, and fiber totals.

estimatedTotalCostInr.description: Approximate total daily ingredient cost in INR.

meals.description: Exactly 5 planned Indian meals (Breakfast, Mid-Morning Snack, Lunch, Evening Snack, Dinner).

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and daily nutrition targets for each authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/meals/{mealId}.description: Private daily food diary entries scoped strictly to the owning user.

/users/{userId}/mealPlans/{planId}.description: Private personalized 5-meal Indian meal plans scoped strictly to the owning user.
